verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents downloading a Page as an Excel workbook that keeps its formulas, which covers the spreadsheet export. It also claims Ari drafts a board deck off last night's numbers, but that is about drafting decks, not exporting reports to a slide file format. The read-only board link is sharing, not export, and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented PDF export, explicit slide/deck file export (e.g., PowerPoint or Google Slides), independent or hands-on corroboration of export behavior.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export reports to slides, PDF, or spreadsheet formats
